pages.title: Two hospitals run 24/7 with security held part-time by IT
pages.keyMessage: CMC runs two hospitals with about 1,200 staff. A team of 25 runs IT, and the IT Infrastructure Manager covers security part-time. One Microsoft 365 account compromise occurred in 2025.

pages.title: Four Criticality A systems carry patient care and daily operations
pages.keyMessage: HIS, PACS, Microsoft 365, and Active Directory are Criticality A. HIS, PACS, and LIS hold sensitive health data, and the HIS and PACS vendors can reach that data remotely.

pages.title: Systems share a partly segmented network with vendor and staff remote access
pages.keyMessage: Medical devices share the corporate network, staff connect through a virtual private network (VPN) without multi-factor authentication (MFA), and three vendors connect remotely. Nine security tools are listed, and one is bought but not deployed.

pages.title: Coverage across seven systems, with a PACS replacement due in 2027
pages.keyMessage: No Criticality A system is rated Good for MFA or administrator accounts. The PACS replacement is contracted for March 2027. The 2025 internal audit left six findings open.

blockLines.text: CMC operates Hospital 1 and Hospital 2 with about 1,200 staff.
HIS and Active Directory tolerate under four hours of downtime. PACS and Microsoft 365 tolerate up to one day.
Seven systems are listed: four Criticality A and three Criticality B, with three hosted on premises.
A disaster recovery site exists but has not been tested, and backups have an online copy only.
Four systems use local application accounts, and six systems have no MFA.
Firewall, antivirus, and email filtering cover all users. The vulnerability scanner license is bought but not deployed.
Four vendors have system or data access, and three of them are Criticality A.
Sensitive health data sits in HIS, PACS, and LIS.
IT has 25 staff, security is a part-time duty, and application support is outsourced.
For MFA, 0 of 4 Criticality A systems are rated Good, and 6 of 7 systems are rated Poor.
Seven systems were listed and four sampled. Six profile answers are Unknown.
In March 2025, one compromised Microsoft 365 mailbox sent phishing email to patients for two hours.
The PACS replacement is contracted for March 2027. The HIS upgrade is planned for January 2028.
The 2025 internal audit has six findings open, and the 2024 website penetration test has four.

Criticality A vendors: Sample HIS vendor, Sample PACS vendor and Sample cloud provider.

proposals.proposal: Merge the three vendor remote access actions into one action.
proposals.rationale: All three change how vendors reach HIS and PACS: supervised access, MFA, and session logging (C7:HIS, C7:PACS, SUP-02).

change.mergedAction: Require MFA, supervision, and session logging for vendor remote access to HIS and PACS, and remove unattended remote tools.

proposals.proposal: Merge the two ransomware tabletop exercise actions into one action.
proposals.rationale: Both actions run a ransomware tabletop exercise with the same participants (IR-04).

change.mergedAction: Hold a tabletop exercise on ransomware each year, starting with a first exercise, and record the improvements in the register.

proposals.proposal: Merge the two remediation timeline actions into one action.
proposals.rationale: Both set timelines by severity and report compliance, one for vulnerabilities and one for patches.

change.mergedAction: Set patch and remediation timelines by severity, track compliance monthly, and report it to the steering committee.

proposals.proposal: Record Ownership as a systemic root cause.
proposals.rationale: Ownership is a root cause in Gap Findings across all six Functions.

change.systemicStatement: No executive owns cybersecurity at CMC, and PACS and Active Directory have an IT owner only, so each control depends on whoever in IT has time and no one checks controls across both hospitals.

proposals.proposal: Record Tooling as a systemic root cause.
proposals.rationale: Tooling is a root cause in Gap Findings across Identify, Protect, Detect, and Respond.

change.systemicStatement: CMC lacks basic security tooling on core systems: no central logging, no vulnerability scanning, no network monitoring, and no MFA on privileged access.

proposals.proposal: Lower the Likelihood of GAP-RC.RP-02 from 4 to 3.
proposals.rationale: The PACS backup is immutable, which blocks part of the attack path.

change.note: HIS, Microsoft 365, and Active Directory still have no restore test, so the assessor may keep Likelihood 4.

proposals.proposal: Link the network segmentation action to GAP-PR.PS-02.
proposals.rationale: Segmentation also isolates legacy medical devices, which supports the isolation action.
